In detail

The single worst-rated district in the City of Kraków's own official resident-safety survey (end of 2022, published January 2023): only 69% of residents said Kraków overall felt safe to them (the lowest of any district in the survey) and 74.0% rated their own district as safe — also the lowest district-specific figure recorded. This is corroborated by the independent 2020 Otodom survey, which rated Bieżanów-Prokocim 3.48/5, in the lower bracket of districts surveyed. It is also grouped with Swoszowice and Podgórze Duchackie in the 2024 police breakdown at a moderate (not exceptional) raw theft/burglary count, so the concern here is specifically about resident-perceived safety rather than a documented violent-crime spike. Sources checked: City of Kraków official resident-safety survey, krakow.pl (published January 2023); Otodom District Ranking 2020; Kraków Nasze Miasto (2024 police district data).
